scope: Frozen read-only inventory of all 24 starting fork branch heads, all 300 pull requests, all four upstream branches and all four upstream pull requests. Subsequent working branch creation is outside the starting inventory.
limitations: This immutable snapshot does not claim that remote branches or main cannot advance after capture. Refresh main and current branch/PR heads before final publication.
Incoming Word qualification is historical evidence, not tests executed by this intake audit.
Historical equivalent PR heads are deliberately not replayed over later source. Exact current Git-object comparisons establish equivalence to ancestor replacements.
